scope: Read fixed official local Redis8.4 source bytes, identical to previously API-verified pinned official source; no fresh network fetch claimed.
facts: Level1 is a valid result: the random-level function starts at1.
The chosen level is known before creating the node and before any new forward-pointer write.
Only levels i<level get the new-node successor and predecessor-splice writes, in bottom-to-top order.
A level1 node does not receive an upper forward link; existing upper forward links remain.
After these forward writes Redis still maintains untouched spans, backward pointers, length and possibly tail. The video is a forward-link illustration, not an exhaustive zslInsert trace.
